title: elaeocarpus calomala var. pustulatus
intro: Elaeocarpus calomala var. pustulatus, commonly known as the Queensland blue quandong, is a plant species within the Elaeocarpaceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and other inflammatory conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate pain, which is achieved through its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. Furthermore, the bioactive constituents of Elaeocarpus calomala var. pustulatus, such as ellagic acid and flavonoids, have been found to exhibit antioxidant and antimicrobial properties, contributing to its therapeutic effects.
